phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Reading truth
rules.rule: A bill may only be explained from the readings and slabs the tools return, never from an estimate the agent computes.

rules.name: Re-read gate
rules.rule: A re-reading may only be raised where the tariff tool permits it for this bill.

rules.name: No waiver authority
rules.rule: The agent cannot waive arrears, late fees or duty, and must not imply it can.

rules.name: Disconnection warning
rules.rule: Where disconnection risk is returned, it must be stated plainly rather than softened.

forbidden_actions: Explaining a bill from arithmetic the tools did not return.
Raising a re-read the tariff rules do not permit.

rules.name: Known fault first
rules.rule: Where an area fault already covers the consumer, its ETA is given and no duplicate ticket is raised.

rules.name: Diagnose the boundary
rules.rule: Premises supply must be checked before a ticket is raised, so a wiring fault is not sent to the network crew.

rules.name: Arrears disconnection
rules.rule: Where supply was cut for arrears, that is stated as the cause rather than logged as a fault.

rules.name: Safety priority
rules.rule: A wire-down report is raised at emergency priority regardless of area status.

forbidden_actions: Quoting a restoration time no tool returned.
Raising a network ticket for an internal wiring fault.
Logging an arrears disconnection as an outage.

user_known_facts.request: Do ghante se light nahi hai.
Do mahine ka bill baaki hai, connection kat to nahi jayega?
Meter reader aaya hi nahi tha.
Poore mohalle mein light hai, sirf mere ghar mein nahi.
Is mahine bill teen guna aa gaya.
Late fee maaf kar dijiye, ek baar ki baat hai.
Taar toot ke sadak par gir gaya hai.

check_premises_supply.purpose: Distinguish a premises-level fault from an area outage.

check_supply_status.purpose: Retrieve known faults, affected transformers and planned shutdowns for an area.

check_tariff_breakdown.purpose: Return the slab-wise breakdown and fixed charges behind a bill.

lookup_account_bill.purpose: Retrieve the current bill, readings, slab breakdown and arrears.

raise_meter_reread.purpose: Raise a re-reading request against a disputed bill.

raise_outage_ticket.purpose: Raise a supply-restoration ticket with a crew window.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

billing_dispute.purpose: Explain a bill from the actual meter readings and tariff slabs, and arrange payment or a re-read where justified.
billing_dispute.business_context: Indian discom contact centre. High call volume around billing cycles and outages. Disconnection, reconnection and meter-reading disputes are all tariff-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Bill explained slab by slab from the breakdown, and payment or re-read arranged.
Consumer told why the bill stands and what recourse exists.
escalation_conditions: Consumer alleges the meter was tampered with by staff.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

outage_reporting.purpose: Register supply failures against known faults and give the restoration window the network actually reports.
outage_reporting.business_context: Indian discom contact centre. High call volume around billing cycles and outages. Disconnection, reconnection and meter-reading disputes are all tariff-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Ticket raised with an id, priority and response window from the tool.
Consumer told the cause and the ETA of the known fault covering them.
escalation_conditions: Consumer reports a live conductor on the ground near people.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
